authorship: Assistant-authored fictional support scenarios and targets, not Bitext rows. Policy and status statements are customer-supplied context, not verified live records.

rows.instruction: The cancellation page says requests are allowed until packing starts. My order screen currently says 'payment received; packing not started'. Is there a next step I can take?

I can't cancel the order or verify its live status here; if packing begins before the request completes, contact official support promptly.
